uncertain_terms.note: 'صادرة ال' in the source (missing letter); read as 'Issued to'.
Ammeter model as written; the characters could be zeros or the letter O. Kept verbatim as 'UM-79OO'.
Step 3 panel label says '220V Battery' on this 48 V document; kept verbatim as in the source.
Step 6 cites charger CB-DH-972A (the 220 V charger code from B-058) on this 48 V document; kept verbatim as in the source.
Step 12 cites CB-DH-971A while steps 4/13/20 cite CB-DL-971A; kept verbatim as in the source.
'المحول' (transformer) is a typo for 'المحلول' (electrolyte); translated as 'electrolyte' by intent.
Source shows corrupted characters where the FLOAT SELECT switch is named; read as 'FLOAT SELECT'.
37 cells × 0.5 ml = 18.5 ml, not the 20 ml stated in the source; translated verbatim as in the source.
uncertain_terms.term: 37 cells, 0.5 ml each, total sample 20 ml
